name: Venice
note: The historic centre from OpenStreetMap, on the shared engine. Venice inverts everything the engine assumes: the canals are the street network and the calli are the exception, every building is its own quay, and the ground is at sea level or under it. Data (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL.
attribution: Venice: map data (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL. Built by tools/build-osm-city.py.

fetch._: the whole lagoon city is a detail zone: every building is kept, because there are no tall ones

districts._: [name, hex colour, base height, tallest, box as [lat south, lon west, lat north, lon east]]

landmarks.name: The Campanile of San Marco
landmarks.info: Ninety-eight metres of brick with a belfry, a spire and a gilt angel on it. It fell down in 1902 and was rebuilt as it was, and it is the only thing in Venice you can see from everywhere.

landmarks.name: Basilica di San Marco
landmarks.info: Five domes over a Greek cross, and the only cathedral on this site that is not a massing box.

landmarks.name: Palazzo Ducale
landmarks.info: The Doge's Palace: two storeys of arcade holding up a wall, which is the wrong way round and the point of it.

landmarks.name: Ponte di Rialto
landmarks.info: A single stone arch over the Grand Canal with two rows of shops on it, finished in 1591 after three collapses of the wooden bridges before it.

landmarks.name: Santa Maria della Salute
landmarks.info: Put up for the end of the plague of 1630, on a million timber piles driven into the mud at the mouth of the Grand Canal.

landmarks.name: San Giorgio Maggiore
landmarks.info: Across the Bacino on its own island, and the best place to look back at the city from.

landmarks.name: The Arsenale
landmarks.info: The shipyard that built the fleet, walled off from the city, and at its height turning out a galley a day.

landmarks.name: Ponte dell'Accademia
landmarks.info: The upstream crossing of the Grand Canal: a timber arch that was meant to be temporary in 1933.

landmarks.name: Santa Maria Gloriosa dei Frari
landmarks.info: The second tallest campanile in the city, and the brick one everybody forgets.

landmarks.name: Punta della Dogana
landmarks.info: The customs point at the tip, where the Grand Canal and the Giudecca canal meet the Bacino.

camera._: the calli and the canals are the subject, and you cannot look along one from above it

boats._: what moves here: the canals are the street network, so the traffic is on the water

life._: the comignoli, the mooring posts, the washing across the calli, the awnings on the campi

landFromCity._: no height grid: the sheet is the lagoon and the islands are rasterised from the buildings, calli and campi
